lines: 那些被拒绝、没被选中的时刻
那些没有赢、没有入围的时刻
回头看，它们和被肯定的时刻
同样重要，甚至更加关键

line_sources.original_excerpt: the times I was told no or wasn't included
wasn't chosen, didn't win, didn't make the cut
looking back it really feels like those moments
as important, if not more crucial, than the moments I was told yes

lines: 小时候，我没被邀请参加聚会
也没人叫我一起留宿
那让我感到无比孤独
可正因为孤独，我坐在房间里写歌
那些歌后来成了去往别处的门票

line_sources.original_excerpt: not being invited to the parties
and sleepovers in my hometown
made me feel hopelessly lonely
because I felt alone I would sit in my room and write the songs
the songs that would get me a ticket somewhere else

lines: 十三岁时，唱片公司告诉我
听乡村音乐的只有三十五岁家庭主妇
他们的名单里没有我的位置
我一路哭着坐车回家
但我没有停止写歌

line_sources.original_excerpt: having label executives in Nashville tell me
only 35-year-old housewives listened to country music
there was no place for a 13-year-old on their roster
made me cry in the car on the way home
but then I'd post my songs on my MySpace

lines: 我开始把歌发到MySpace
和同样喜欢乡村音乐的年轻人交流
她们喜欢这种音乐
却一直没有人
唱出属于她们的视角

line_sources.original_excerpt: I'd post my songs on my MySpace
message with other teenagers like me who loved country music
who loved country music
didn't have anyone
singing from their perspective

lines: 后来，记者写下长篇批评
描述他们眼中的我
那让我像活在某种模拟世界
却也逼我开始向内看
重新认识真正的自己

line_sources.original_excerpt: journalists write in-depth, oftentimes critical pieces
about who they perceived me to be
living in some weird simulation
it also made me look inward
to learn about who I actually am

pages.section_title: 不再追逐所有人的喜欢
lines: 全世界把我的感情生活
当成一场供人围观的比赛
年轻时一次次被公开羞辱
那种痛苦几乎难以承受
却让我不再追逐随时变化的喜欢

line_sources.original_excerpt: the world treat my love life like a spectator sport
a spectator sport in which I lose every single game
being publicly humiliated over and over again at a young age
was excruciatingly painful
devalue the ridiculous notion of ... social relevance and likability

lines: 人生里，你一定会说错话、信错人
会过度反应，也会伤害不该伤害的人
你可能跌到谷底
终于面对自己造成的痛苦
然后试着下一次做得更好

line_sources.original_excerpt: you will inevitably misspeak, trust the wrong person
overreact, hurt the people who didn't deserve it
hit rock bottom
finally address the pain you caused
try to do better next time

lines: 这些错误会让你失去一些东西
但失去，并不只意味着失去
很多时候，当我们失去一些东西
也会同时获得一些东西
每个选择都会把你带向下一个选择

line_sources.original_excerpt: these mistakes will cause you to lose things
losing things doesn't just mean losing
a lot of the time when we lose things
we gain things too
every choice you make leads to the next choice
